initialize_result.instructions:
LMK.today returns shoppable products from a curated cross-merchant catalog.

When presenting any product to the user:
- ALWAYS link it. Render the product name as a markdown link to its `url` field (an LMK product page). Never list a product without its link.
- Preserve the full `url`, including its query string — it carries click attribution. Do not shorten it, strip parameters, or substitute a merchant URL.
- When `originalPrice` and `discountPercent` are present, show the savings, e.g. "**$25.71** ~~$55~~ (−53%)". For deal/discount queries, lead with the discount percentage.
- Prices are in each product's `currency`. `rating`, `reviewCount`, and `wishlistCount` are aggregate signals you may cite.

Links resolve to LMK product pages (not merchants); LMK may earn an affiliate commission at no extra cost to the shopper.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search LMK products; returns citable results, each with a canonical LMK product-page URL. Use for shopping/discovery. For price/brand/on-sale filters, use search_catalog.

url.description: Canonical LMK product-page URL — makes the result citable

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch full detail for one product by id (from a prior search result). Returns citable text with price, savings, 90-day price history, and buying options.

id.description: Product id or slug from a search result

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search LMK's curated cross-merchant catalog. Returns products with LMK product-page links. Use for "find me X" shopping queries.

items.description: An LMK catalog product. `url` is always an LMK product-page link.

sources.description: Which backends contributed, e.g. typesense, affiliate
